title: 第1194章 有人许了两次愿第1193章 一人只能许一个愿望
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 天道愿意无条件满足许愿者的愿望，只需要能让天道听到你的愿望，天道就会帮你实现。
没有代价，不扭曲愿望。
堪称完美的许愿神灯。
但正如阿拉丁神灯只能许下三个愿望一样，对天道的许愿，也只有一次。
一般来说，天道会感知到你内心最深处的渴望，并以此作为你的愿望。
当然，你提，它也会按你的要求帮忙。
只要你说得够清楚。
唯一的限制是，每个人都只有一个愿望。
“每个人只有一个愿望？可如果这样的话，渡劫成仙后，获取道果就算一个了吧，那许愿让你忘了算是第二个了吧。
这是怎么回事呢？”
李遁一立刻发现了只能许一个愿望的漏洞。
突破成仙、取得道果，默认算是一个愿望，那所有仙人，都应该没有和天道意志许愿的机会了才对。
“对啊，好奇怪，为什么他能许两个愿望呢？”
天道意志这会儿也发现了不对。
“你也不知道？”
李遁一皱眉道。
“肯定是跟着一起忘了。”
李遁一也没有在这个问题上太纠结，不管是什么原因，反正自己拿着劫罚，以不变应万变。
早晚能直面对方，知道真相的。
“我真的要走了，有什么需要我帮你的吗？”
“没有了，出去要小心打雷，我的‘劫罚’到了你的手里，外界可能会有点不稳定哦。”
确实要小心打雷，上方的赵氏旧王陵，那些士兵还没离去，就听晴空忽生一声惊雷，吓了所有人一跳。
没等士兵们有所反应，一道闪电劈在了旧王陵上。
被闪电击中的地方，泥土炸开一个盘子大的浅坑，焦黑的草茬在坑的边缘蜷曲着。
坑底，几根手指粗的玻璃管斜插土中，表面粗糙，泛着暗绿与酱黄的光泽，内壁中空。
那是闪电的瞬间高温熔化土壤里的沙子形成的闪电熔岩。
灼热的气味混着草木灰的气味，冲进了附近士兵的鼻腔。
“雷神爷发怒了！
快趴下！
匍匐着走！
离那里远一点！”
一声吼叫，终于是叫醒了被闪电吓蒙的士兵。
更远处，已经走远了的独孤一族探险队成员也听到了这晴空惊雷。
又有异象！
这是走早了啊！
怎么就这么不赶巧了呢？偏偏异象发生的时候碰见军士搜查。
此刻他们已经开始纠结要不要回去看看了。
再远一点的凡人域各处，也开始随机降下落雷。
运气好的，只是劈到无人之地，运气不好的，就劈在倒霉路人身上了。
本来有隔绝大阵在，道果影响是不会在凡人域产生影响才对。
之前李遁一和仙人交手，道果力量外泄影响自然现象，不管是弛洪仙尊引发的洪水、震龙尊引发的地震、还是燃灰仙人的死灰复燃，都没有波及到凡人域。
也就是太阴幽荧的“朔月”
影响的是月相，在凡人域也能观察到。
content_en:
Heaven is willing to fulfill the wish of the wisher unconditionally. You only need to let Heaven hear your wish, and Heaven will help you realize it.
No price, no distortion of wishes.
It is the perfect wishing lamp.
But just as Aladdin's magic lamp can only make three wishes, he can only make one wish for heaven.
Generally speaking, Heaven will sense your deepest desire and use it as your wish.
Of course, if you ask, it will help you as well.
As long as you make it clear enough.
The only limitation is that everyone has only one wish.
"Everyone has only one wish? But if that's the case, after overcoming the tribulation and becoming an immortal, obtaining the Dao Fruit would be considered one, and making a wish to make you forget would be considered the second.
What's going on? "
Li Dunyi immediately discovered the loophole in which he could only make one wish.
Breaking through to become an immortal and obtaining the Dao Fruit is considered a wish by default, so all immortals should have no chance to make a wish with the will of heaven.
"Yeah, it's so strange, why can he make two wishes?"
The will of heaven also discovered something was wrong at this moment.
"You don't know either?"
Li Dunyi frowned.
"I must have forgotten it along with it."
"Okay..."
Li Dunyi didn't get too entangled in this issue. No matter what the reason was, he took the punishment and stayed the same to cope with all changes.
Sooner or later, you will be able to face the other party and know the truth.
"I really have to leave, is there anything I can do for you?"
"No more. Be careful of thunder when you go out. If my 'punishment' is in your hands, the outside world may be a little unstable."
…
Be careful of thunder. Before the soldiers left the Zhao family's old royal mausoleum above, they heard a sudden thunder in the clear sky, startling everyone.
Before the soldiers could react, a bolt of lightning struck the old royal tomb.
Where the lightning struck, a shallow pit as big as a plate opened in the soil, and blackened grass stubble curled up around the edges.
At the bottom of the pit, several finger-thick glass tubes were inserted diagonally into the soil. The surface was rough, glowing with dark green and yellowish colors, and the inner walls were hollow.
It is lightning lava formed by the instantaneous high temperature of lightning melting the sand in the soil.
The burning smell mixed with the smell of plant ash rushed into the nostrils of the nearby soldiers.
"Thunder God is angry!
Get down!
Walk on all fours!
Stay away from there! "
A roar finally woke up the soldiers who were frightened by lightning.
Further away, the members of the Dugu Clan expedition team who had already gone far also heard the thunder in the clear sky.
Another vision!
It's too early to leave!
How could it be so unlucky? It happened that when the vision happened, I encountered a sergeant conducting a search.
At this moment, they were beginning to debate whether to go back and take a look.
Further away in the mortal realm, thunder began to fall randomly.
If you're lucky, you'll just hit an uninhabited land; if you're unlucky, you'll hit an unlucky passerby.
Originally, there was a great isolation formation, so the influence of Dao Fruit would not have an impact on the mortal realm.
In the previous battle between Li Dunyi and the Immortal, the power of Dao Fruit leaked out and affected natural phenomena. Whether it was the flood caused by Chi Hong Immortal, the earthquake caused by Zhen Long Zun, or the resurgence of Burning Ash Immortal, none of them affected the mortal realm.
That is the "new moon" of Taiyin Youying
It affects the phases of the moon, which can also be observed in the mortal realm.
